import fs from 'node:fs';
fs.writeFileSync('.dip-local/release-0.3.5.md', '# Write plans once

Keep the complete plan in Markdown. DIP links supported successful file writes to their pre-tool task and stores only path, role, SHA-256 and size metadata.

- New MCP/CLI tools link, list, read and unlink document sources.
- Heading and Unicode lexical queries retrieve bounded excerpts with content versions and continuation.
- The dashboard shows references and safe plain-text sections.
- Changed, missing or conflicting documents remain explicit and invalidate verification evidence.
- Checkout-root aliases work across macOS and Windows; document symlinks and unsafe paths are rejected.
- Agent instructions and the bundled skill avoid rewriting Markdown prose into task plans.

Local configured verification passed 83 cases: 81 Windows passes, two POSIX skips, zero failures; browser, fresh package, skill and installed adapter command checks passed. A real trusted Codex write linked QA_REPORT.md automatically in the development session. Claude command tests use synthetic lifecycle inputs, not a live Claude session.

Existing MCP connections need reloading after upgrade. Arbitrary shell/wrapper writes without supported file schemas require explicit linking. Retrieval is lexical, source files are limited to 1 MiB, and no model-quality or token-saving claim is made.

Use at your own risk. Review automation and run project verification checks before relying on completion status.
');
'@ | node --input-type=module
